historicalSnapshot.policy: preserve as immutable historical evidence; do not treat its enforcer-memory paths as current authority

parserVariants.definition: Canonical identities in the reviewed enforcer-syntax language registry and Language::ALL projection.

structuralLanguages.definition: Registry identities whose structural disposition is ParseFile.

explicitNoneDispatch.definition: Registry identities whose structural disposition is NoParseFile.

grammarCargoDeclarations.definition: Direct tree-sitter declarations in the current syntax owner Cargo manifest.

grammarBindings.definition: Distinct grammar bindings excluding the tree-sitter core crate.

vendoredGrammarFiles.definition: Tracked files below the current syntax owner's vendor root.

vendorGrammarTopLevelDirs.definition: Distinct first-level grammar directories below the current syntax owner's vendor root.

langSpecRows.definition: Language specification rows in the current syntax owner's LangSpec source.

drift.sourcePathPolicy: Current evidence must use enforcer-syntax paths; old enforcer-memory paths remain only in the historical snapshot or explicit migration records.
